title: Rank within subject
prompt: Return each student, subject, score, and their RANK() (as rnk) within their subject ordered by score descending.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE scores (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student TEXT, subject TEXT, score INTEGER); INSERT INTO scores VALUES (1,'A','Math',90),(2,'B','Math',90),(3,'C','Math',80),(4,'D','Science',70),(5,'E','Science',95);
reference_sql: SELECT student, subject, score, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY subject ORDER BY score DESC) AS rnk FROM scores;
